messages:
maria: Quick sync — bringing up Aegis-9B (int6) for production evaluation. Posting summary numbers and a proposed canary plan.
chris: TL;DR numbers from bench vs current Nova-7B (int8). Throughput: +1.6x. Token cost: ~0.55x. Latency p50 +5ms, p99 +20ms. Overall eval score +0.9% on GTN testset.
devin: Product asks: is the unit-econ win big enough to change default routing? Need clear slices to hold back.
maria: Breakdown: wins on summarization, chit-chat, and short-answer slices. Regressions on long-form code-gen and legal/contract templates (recall & formatting).
sam: Infra sanity: int6 kernels stable on A100/ H100, KV cache unaffected. Memory drop ~8%, which helps batch density. Recommend small canary to validate tail latency under real traffic.
chris: Quick scorecard snapshot (summary):
- avg tokens/request: 150
- cost per 1k tokens: Aegis-int6 $0.40 vs Nova-int8 $0.72
- p50 latency: 88ms vs 83ms
- p99 latency: 380ms vs 360ms
- eval delta (composite): +0.9% overall, -0.3% longform recall slice
Note: numbers are from mixed-slice offline replay (10k samples) — not live.
alejandra: From GTN perspective: big cost wins on high-volume routes are attractive. But we must avoid routing Aegis to legal/code product funnels until we see no regressions for 1 week.
maria: Proposed canary / routing flags (example):
```json
{
  "model": "aegis-9b-int6",
  "canary": {
    "duration_hours": 48,
    "initial_traffic_pct": 5,
    "max_traffic_pct": 25,
    "slices_allowlist": ["summarization", "help_center", "short_answer"],
    "slices_blocklist": ["code_generation", "legal_templates", "contracts"]
  },
  "rollback_conditions": {
    "quality_drop_pct": 0.5,
    "latency_p99_increase_pct": 15,
    "error_rate_increase_pct": 0.2
  }
}
```
devin: Suggest tweak: start at 10% for 24h for high-volume non-critical routes (summ, faq). If metrics stable, expand to 25% routed by product tag. Also add automated eval hooks to run daily slice checks.
sam: Ops note: enable detailed tracing and token-level cost logging for the canary. We'll watch GPU utilization and queue depths. If p99 jumps >15% we kill.
chris: Running quick unit-econ back-of-envelope for 1M daily requests (avg 150 tokens):
- tokens/day = 150M
- cost Aegis-int6 ≈ $60k/day (using $0.40 per 1k tokens)
- cost Nova-int8 ≈ $108k/day
- daily savings ≈ $48k -> ~44% savings on token bill
Add in ops delta: slightly higher tail latency risk but no additional infra dollars expected since throughput improves.
alejandra: GTN ask: prepare comms for customers on subtle behavior differences (esp. longform). We'll label defaults and expose opt-in for riskier routes.
maria: Recommendation summary: 1) Start canary immediately with slices_allowlist above at 10% for 24h. 2) Monitor composite quality delta and per-slice deltas; rollback if composite <-0.5% or any blocked slice shows regression >0.3%. 3) If stable for 48h, broaden to 25% and add hybrid routing for code/contract routes to fallback to Nova on low-confidence responses.
devin: Agreed. I'll own product gating and rollout approvals. Alejandra will own GTN comms. Maria + Chris + Sam handle eval/ops hooks.
ops-bot: Canary job aegis-9b-int6 started (canary_id: c-2026-744321). 10% traffic to slices: summarization, help_center, short_answer. Monitoring: eval-daily, infra-trace.
maria: Leaving this open for updates — next check-in in 12 hours. :thumbsup:
